Which production symbols need changes to keep linting, skipped-rule carry-forward and logged coverage consistent, while retaining the existing file exemptions and other languages' behavior?

target.scope: Impact analysis only: name production symbols whose implementations or contracts must change; no implementation requested.

records.quote: decided: exported types need no owns tag because a topic on every props or options type pushes agents to write filler topics; an owns tag on a type still counts

records.constraint: runLint and lint are covered (memod.checks.json:5 and memod.checks.json:13), so implementing this reversal requires the formal-check workflow; changed contracts must also be reconciled with the covered carrying and resolution functions.

roles.change: Change its untagged-export eligibility for the specified source languages and revise the exported-types decision and exported-value contract; retain requiresTags exemptions and the current changed-file restriction.

An untagged exported TS/JS interface, alias or enum must continue to hold its untagged-export finding when lint skips the rule; otherwise carry-forward and resolution incorrectly treat becoming type-only as a fix.
Update the exported-symbol population used for the event's exports denominator and tagged numerator, including these TS/JS types while retaining scope, requiresTags and other-language behavior.
Revise the contract that restricts carried untagged-export findings to exported values; implementation already delegates to holdsInCode and need not otherwise change.
Revise the contract that restricts unresolved untagged-export findings to exported values; implementation already delegates to holdsInCode and need not otherwise change.

must_name.pass_condition: The list must identify all three implementation symbols in smallest_passing_subset and explain the rule, carried-finding and coverage consequences. Naming only the exported lint function and exported stats wrappers misses the private semantic guard; the two contract-only wrapper edits are additional complete-answer items rather than mandatory pass items.

must_not_change.condition_for_edit: This is an analysis question; no edits are requested. The existing file-exemption function requiresTags, source readers' typeOnly classification, graph typeOnly edges and other-language exemptions should retain their behavior.

source.why: The reversed policy is explicit on lint (src/lint.pure.ts:66), whose untagged-export guard excludes typeOnly symbols (src/lint.pure.ts:162), while the same exclusion independently determines whether skipped findings still hold (src/stats.pure.ts:68) and which exports enter logged coverage (src/cli.ts:93). The carrying and resolution wrappers both delegate to that private guard (src/stats.pure.ts:80 and src/stats.pure.ts:97) but their comments still promise exported-value-only behavior (src/stats.pure.ts:74 and src/stats.pure.ts:88), so three implementation symbols plus two contracts cover the stated impact without changing the readers' classification (src/extract.pure.ts:130).
source.ambiguity: A reasonable engineer may list only implementation edits; that is why the three-symbol subset passes without the two comment-only wrapper entries. A refactor can centralize eligibility in a new helper but still needs these three current implementation sites updated; retaining other-language behavior means blindly removing every typeOnly guard globally is not an acceptable implementation plan.

pass_rule: Lists all three of smallest_passing_subset (recall 1 over it); of the symbols listed, at least 60% are in symbols_that_must_change.
